edges.fact: Neff Music is run by saxophonist and educator Eric Neff, who shares his knowledge on jazz improvisation, technique, and music theory
The Jazz Improvisation online course is offered by the University of Edinburgh, covering scales, modes, and chord progressions
The Jazz Improvisation course is hosted on Coursera
